result.summary: The home screen has several visual layout problems: truncated restaurant names, a cut-off category chip, duplicate nearby cards, and overlapping UI on the promo banner.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped at the right edge, cutting off the image, delivery time, and name ('Smash Bros Bu').
issues.suggestion: Add consistent card width, horizontal padding, and snap/peek so the last visible card is fully readable or clearly indicates more content.

issues.description: The first two 'Fastest near you' cards appear identical (same photo, name, time, and delivery fee), which looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each card maps to a unique restaurant and add a fallback if the feed returns duplicates.

issues.description: The category chips row is cut off on the right, showing only a sliver of the next chip with no fade or chevron.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade/scroll hint so users can tell the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The green promo banner's decorative circle overlaps the 'Order now' button and right edge, making the CTA feel cramped.
issues.suggestion: Give the button more right padding or clip/reposition the background graphic so it does not collide with interactive elements.

issues.description: The last popular restaurant card is cropped by the bottom tab bar, hiding most of the restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards are not hidden behind navigation.
